versions.content: The Crypto Stack API should support the possibility to move a state of a “counter mode” stream cipher to a random position Status: DRAFT Description: The Crypto Stack API should support the possibility to utilize the especial benefit of stream ciphers in the “counter mode” (like CTR or GCM) to move their states to random positions directly. Rationale: Basic functionality, e.g. it is required for “on-the-fly” encryption/decryption of a large data storage. Dependencies: – Use Case: – Supporting Material: –
